changelog: - **A coffee roasting batch joins the Templates.** File ▸ Templates has a new process example after the desalination plant: one 54 kg batch of coffee from the hopper through the roasting drum and the cooling tray to roasted beans, one minute per step. Step 1 charges the drum; steps 2–13 are 12 minutes of roasting in three phases (drying, browning, development), in which water vapour, volatiles and chaff leave the drum; step 14 drops the beans into the cooling tray; steps 15–18 are 4 minutes of cooling; and step 19 discharges 44.64 kg of roasted beans, after which the run ends. Coffee mass is a conserved kind, so the amounts add up to 54 kg at every step. Every number is an example assumption, not a measurement or a plant value; the cooling steps show time only, and no temperature is computed; the gas and heat of the burner, afterburner and stack are not in the model. Help ▸ Example notes explains it, and its names follow all 18 languages.
